dedupe_keys.name: open database of educational facilities odef statistics canada

description: The Open Database of Educational Facilities is Statistics Canada's compilation of open and internet sources on the locations and types of educational facilities across Canada, originating from municipal, regional and provincial governments, harmonised into one repository. Version 2.1 was published on 28 November 2022, and the database is expected to be updated periodically as new open government data become available. Coverage: Canada, as far as source governments publish school data. Access: zipped CSV files in English and French from Statistics Canada, with a record on the Open Government Portal. Licence: Open Government Licence - Canada; free. Caveats: completeness and attributes depend on the source datasets, and locations are points, not building footprints. Simulation uses are locating schools for hazard exposure and for their role as shelters and community facilities in emergency planning. Related records: the Open Database of Buildings from the same programme.
